title: Lower ME: Back Squat
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Tri-Planar Ankle × 8/side · Inchworm Walk × 4 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side · A-skip 2 × 20 yd · B-skip 2 × 20 yd
jumps: Back Squat 3 · 3-sec pause @ RPE 8 → Hurdle Hops 5 → Trap Bar Jump 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Isometric wk 1: dead-stop 3-sec pause at the bottom, no bounce · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · no hurdles? Tuck jumps
strength: Slow, hold a rack or wall
note: Isometric phase: 3-second dead-stop pause at the bottom of every main-lift rep. Heavier again.
